introduction:
The Khadya Sathi Digital Ration Card (DRC) in West Bengal is issued by the Department of Food & Supplies, Government of West Bengal. Under the Khadya Sathi scheme, it provides comprehensive food security by offering highly subsidised or free food grains through e-POS enabled Fair Price Shops (FPS).

West Bengal operates robust state-sponsored schemes like Rajya Khadya Suraksha Yojana (RKSY) alongside the central NFSA. The Digital Ration Card and the e-Ration Card are universally accepted as valid proof of identity and residence across the state.
quickFacts:
Important to Know
  • Purpose: The video demonstrates how citizens of West Bengal can apply online using their mobile phones to add left-out family members or children to an existing family ration card.
  • Form Used: Form 4 is specifically used for adding members to a family where some members already possess a valid ration card.
  • Fees: Any service related to the Ration Card, including this application, is completely free of cost.
  • Processing: Applications are verified by an area Inspector and subsequently approved by the respective BDO or Sub-Divisional Controller.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required

Document Specifications: Scanned files must be in JPEG, JPG, or PDF format and must not exceed 300 KB in size.
Identity Documents
  • Aadhaar Card of Existing Member: Required for initial portal login via OTP.
  • For the New Beneficiary (Adults/Children above 5 years): Aadhaar Card is mandatory.
  • For Children under 5 years: Birth Certificate is acceptable if an Aadhaar card is not available.
Address Proof
  • Address Proof: Necessary if the current address differs from the one on the Aadhaar card.
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Apply Online via Food Dept Portal

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Access the Portal: Open a web browser on your mobile or computer and navigate to the official West Bengal Food & Supplies Department website: food.wb.gov.in.
  2. Navigate to Services: Click on the "Citizen's Home" section, then select "Ration Card Related Corner".
  3. Initiate Login: Click on "Services Requiring Office Approval" and then select "Apply Online".
  4. Aadhaar Authentication: Enter the Aadhaar number of the Head of the Family (or any existing member with a valid ration card). An OTP will be sent to the Aadhaar-linked mobile number. Enter the OTP and click "Submit OTP".
  5. Confirm Details: The portal will display the existing ration card details. Confirm that they belong to your family and click "Next".
  6. Select Form: On the dashboard, scroll down to the "Online Form Services" section and click on Form 4 (Apply for ration card of left out members of the family).
  7. Verify Existing Members: Provide a contact mobile number if required, review the list of currently enrolled family members, and proceed.
  8. Enter New Member Details:
    • Select the Document Type (Aadhaar or Birth Certificate) for the new member.
    • Enter the document number and click "Verify".
    • Fill in the required personal details: Name, Date of Birth, Gender, Caste, Guardian's Name, Guardian Type, and the Relationship with the Head of the Family.
    • Add Address details accurately (District, Block/Municipality, Gram Panchayat, Village, Post Office, PIN Code, Police Station).
  9. Upload Documents: Upload the scanned copy of the chosen identity document (Aadhaar or Birth Certificate) keeping the file size under 300 KB.
  10. Final Submission: Check the self-declaration consent boxes and click "Final Submit". An acknowledgment message with an Application Number will appear on the screen.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Apply Offline

As the video solely focuses on the online method, the following steps are sourced from the official West Bengal Food and Supplies Department guidelines:

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Obtain Form 4: Download "Form 4" for Rural or Urban areas from the 'Forms' section on the official website (food.wb.gov.in), or collect a physical copy from your nearest Food Inspector office, Rationing Office, BDO office, or during 'Duare Sarkar' camps.
  2. Fill the Form: Fill out the hard copy with accurate details of the existing Head of Family, the current ration card numbers, and the specific details of the new member being added.
  3. Attach Documents: Attach self-attested photocopies of the required documents, including the Aadhaar card/Birth Certificate of the new member, Aadhaar cards of existing members, and proof of address.
  4. Submit: Submit the fully filled application form and attached documents in person at your nearest Food Inspector office, Rationing Office, or local municipal/BDO office.
  5. Acknowledgement: Ensure you collect the acknowledgment receipt/slip from the officer for tracking purposes.
afterApplying:
After Applying — What Next?

Track Status

You can monitor the progress of your application by logging into the Citizen dashboard or by using the "Check Application Status" tool on the portal utilizing your application number or mobile number.

Verification

The application will go through a verification stage ("Pending at Inspector") followed by final approval ("Approved by Approving Authority").

e-Ration Card

Once approved, an electronic version (e-Ration Card) is immediately generated and can be downloaded from the portal. This e-card is valid for collecting rations.

Physical Card

The department will dispatch the physical printed ration card to your registered home address via Speed Post.
